english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial word for a short video or video clip.

exampleSentences.english: I watched Ming’s video clip yesterday and laughed so hard my stomach hurt.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我尋日睇咗阿明嗰片，笑到肚痛。
